content.short: SQD enables permissionless, cost-efficient access to petabytes of high-value Web3 data.
content.description: SQD is a decentralized, hyper-scalable data platform designed to provide fast, permissionless access to vast volumes of on-chain information. It makes available historical data such as event logs, transaction receipts, traces, and per-transaction state diffs, empowering developers to build custom data extraction and processing pipelines. With indexing speeds reaching up to 150k blocks per second, SQD supports high-throughput querying and robust data workflows across multiple blockchains and ecosystems.
